scripts.android:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.android:open: sh -ac 'set -a; . ./.env; set +a; exec cap open android'
scripts.android:adb-reset: sh -ac 'set -a; . ./.env; set +a; SDK_ROOT="${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-$HOME/Android/Sdk}"; export ADB_VENDOR_KEYS="${ADB_VENDOR_KEYS:-$HOME/.android/adbkey}"; "$SDK_ROOT/platform-tools/adb" kill-server >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; exec "$SDK_ROOT/platform-tools/adb" start-server'
scripts.android:emulator: sh -ac 'set -a; . ./.env; set +a; SDK_ROOT="${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-$HOME/Android/Sdk}"; GPU_MODE="${ANDROID_EMULATOR_GPU_MODE:-swiftshader_indirect}"; export PATH="$SDK_ROOT/platform-tools:$PATH"; export ADB_VENDOR_KEYS="${ADB_VENDOR_KEYS:-$HOME/.android/adbkey}"; "$SDK_ROOT/platform-tools/adb" kill-server >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; "$SDK_ROOT/platform-tools/adb" start-server >/dev/null; exec "$SDK_ROOT/emulator/emulator" -avd "${ANDROID_EMULATOR_NAME:-Small_Phone}" -gpu "$GPU_MODE" -no-snapshot-load ${ANDROID_EMULATOR_FLAGS:-}'
